title: BONCAT-FACS on River Water and Sewage Effluent Samples
author: Katharine Moss
materials: Before use, remove all reagents from fridge/ freezer and allow to come up to/ thaw at Room temperature .

The volumetric amounts of reagents in steps 16 and 17 are for one sample's worth. It is recommended to make enough for n + 1 samples (n = number of samples). To make dye premix, add together 2.5 µL of CuSO 4 , 5 µL of THPTA and 19 µL of Alexa Fluor 488 picolyl azide. Invert tube. Incubate in the dark at Room temperature for 00:03:00 .
For DNA extraction, follow the manufacturer's standard protocol for the Qiagen DNeasy UltraClean Microbial kit.

steps.title: Prepare HPG stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 100 mg of L‑homopropargylglycine (HPG) in 1 mL Milli‑Q water to obtain a 100 mg/mL solution; store at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Prepare CuSO4·5H2O solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.5 g of CuSO₄·5H₂O in 100 mL Milli‑Q water to make a 20 mM solution; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare THPTA stock and working
steps.instruction: Make a 1.15 M THPTA stock by dissolving 500 mg THPTA in 1 mL Milli‑Q water, then prepare a 50 mM working solution by diluting 10 µL stock with 220 µL Milli‑Q water; store stock at –20 °C and aliquot working solutions to limit freeze‑thaw cycles.

steps.title: Prepare Alexa Fluor azide solutions
steps.instruction: Create a 6.5 mM Alexa Fluor 488 picolyl azide stock by dissolving 5 mg in 1 mL molecular‑grade DMSO, then make a 0.13 mM working solution by diluting 10 µL stock with 490 µL DMSO; store both at –20 °C in the dark and aliquot working solutions.

steps.title: Prepare sodium ascorbate solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.8 g sodium ascorbate in 40 mL 1× PBS to obtain a fresh 100 mM solution.

steps.title: Prepare ethanol solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare 50 % (v/v), 80 % (v/v) and 96 % (v/v) ethanol solutions with Milli‑Q water.

steps.title: Prepare aminoguanidine HCl solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.4 g aminoguanidine hydrochloride in 40 mL 1× PBS to make a fresh 100 mM solution.

steps.title: Add HPG to water samples
steps.instruction: To each 25 mL river water or sewage effluent sample add 32 µL of the 100 mg/mL HPG stock (final HPG = 1 mM); incubate in the dark at room temperature for 15 min. Include 3–4 replicates per sample and negative controls without HPG.

steps.title: Fix samples with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 25 mL molecular‑grade ethanol to each sample (final ethanol = 50 % v/v); incubate in the dark at room temperature for 1 h.

steps.title: Set up filter funnels
steps.instruction: Assemble 25 mm diameter filter funnels fitted with 0.2 µm PVDF filters; connect to a vacuum pump or tap and label each funnel with the sample name.

steps.title: Condition filters
steps.instruction: Pass approximately 5 mL of 50 % (v/v) ethanol through each filter to condition them.

steps.title: Filter ethanol‑fixed samples
steps.instruction: Vacuum‑filter each ethanol‑fixed sample onto its prepared PVDF filter.

steps.title: Wash filters with 80% ethanol
steps.instruction: Release vacuum, add 0.5 mL of 80 % (v/v) ethanol onto each filter, incubate 3 min in the dark, then re‑apply vacuum to remove the ethanol.

steps.title: Wash filters with 96% ethanol and dry
steps.instruction: Release vacuum, add 0.5 mL of 96 % (v/v) ethanol, incubate 3 min, vacuum‑remove ethanol, then vacuum‑dry the filter for ~10 min.

steps.title: Prepare click‑dye premix
steps.instruction: In a tube combine 25 µL sodium ascorbate, 25 µL aminoguanidine HCl solution, and 423.5 µL 1× PBS; invert gently (do not vortex). This yields a reaction mixture with 5 µM Alexa Fluor 488 picolyl azide. Keep mixture on ice to maintain reducing conditions.

steps.title: Incubate filters with click‑dye
steps.instruction: Release vacuum, cover each filter with 0.5 mL of the click‑dye premix, incubate in the dark (foil‑covered) at room temperature for 30 min.

steps.title: Wash filters with PBS (three times)
steps.instruction: Release vacuum, add 0.5 mL 1× PBS to each filter, incubate 3 min, vacuum‑remove; repeat the PBS wash two additional times (total three washes).

steps.title: Additional 50% ethanol wash
steps.instruction: After the PBS washes, repeat a single wash with 0.5 mL of 50 % (v/v) ethanol, incubate 3 min, then vacuum‑remove.

steps.title: Transfer filters to o‑ring tubes
steps.instruction: Using clean tweezers, place each filter into a 2 mL o‑ring tube with the filter surface facing inward; rinse tweezers with 70 % (v/v) ethanol between samples.

steps.title: Add and clean stainless‑steel beads
steps.instruction: Add six stainless‑steel ball bearings to each tube. Clean beads by sonication in 70 % (v/v) ethanol for 10 min, then dry in an oven at 40 °C.

steps.title: Add PBS to tubes
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL 1× PBS to each tube containing the filter and beads.

steps.title: Vortex/shake tubes
steps.instruction: Vortex or shake the tubes at maximum speed for 3 min to dislodge cells from the filter.

steps.title: Aliquot bacterial suspension
steps.instruction: Aliquot 1 mL of the resulting bacterial suspension into fresh 2 mL o‑ring tubes.

steps.title: Add ethanol and store suspension
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL molecular‑grade ethanol to each 1 mL suspension (final ethanol = 50 % v/v); store at –20 °C for up to 2 weeks.

steps.title: Dilute ethanol‑fixed sample
steps.instruction: Dilute 300 µL of the ethanol‑fixed sample with 200 µL sterile‑filtered 1× PBS.

steps.title: Sort BONCAT‑positive cells
steps.instruction: Run the prepared samples on a flow cytometer; sort 500,000 events from the BONCAT‑positive gate in semi‑purity mode into 5 mL tubes containing 1 mL sterile‑filtered 1× PBS. Keep the event rate below 3,000 events s⁻¹ by lowering sample pressure if needed.

steps.title: Run negative control for gating
steps.instruction: Run a negative control (no HPG) on an SH800S sorter at a sample pressure of 5 (units as instrument default). Set the BONCAT‑positive gate to include <0.1 % of the negative population on an AF 488 vs. FSC density plot; use a 488 nm laser and set FSC threshold to 2.

steps.title: Vacuum‑concentrate sorted pellets
steps.instruction: Place the sorted cell suspensions in a vacuum concentrator and dry to completeness.

steps.title: Store pellets for DNA extraction
steps.instruction: Store the dried cell pellets at –80 °C until downstream DNA extraction.
